title: L'NU Joker and JRDW released a new single called "Bad One."
htmlContent:
L'NU Joker is a Canadian-based artist who always puts on the best hip-hop rap songs that give the true feeling of everything he says.

"Bad one" is a romantic and awesome song that divulges the feeling and secrets of being with a Bad one, but you get only good feelings from the bad one. This tells a story of romance and how he met a bad one and reminisced on how good it felt to be with a bad girl.

I'm Joker, an indigenous hip-hop artist and a member of the K.U.$.H group, He is a committed artist, and his sound is a blend of upbeat, romantic, and smooth that leaves you basking in the euphoria of his extraordinary rendition. Enough being said, we had to feature him on our page.
